direction-type.words: Wiggly: Hello, Mister Prezzy-wes! Welcome to Drowsy-Town!
Wiggly: Don't be frightened, you're my bestest buddy-wud!
Howie: No! I've come to tell you to leave us alone!
Wiggly: Leave? Just before Christmas? It's going to be my birthday, you know?
Wiggly: I wouldn't want to miss out on opening all my presents. I think I'll start with you!
I'm going to cut open your belly-well and deeeck the haalls with your gutsy-wutsies!
McNamara: Your minions may do me no harm, Wiggly. For I cut through them with a blade of truth!
